source_reviews_select_public.name: source_reviews_select_public
source_reviews_select_public.using: exists(select 1 from "sources" s where s.id = "source_reviews"."source_id" and s.verification_status in ('approved', 'reviewed'))

concept_localizations_select_published.name: concept_localizations_select_published
concept_localizations_select_published.using: exists(select 1 from "concepts" c where c.id = "concept_localizations"."concept_id" and c.verification_status = 'published')

deity_localizations_select_published.name: deity_localizations_select_published
deity_localizations_select_published.using: exists(select 1 from "deities" d where d.id = "deity_localizations"."deity_id" and d.verification_status = 'published')

festival_localizations_select_published.name: festival_localizations_select_published
festival_localizations_select_published.using: exists(select 1 from "festivals" f where f.id = "festival_localizations"."festival_id" and f.verification_status = 'published')

mantra_localizations_select_published.name: mantra_localizations_select_published
mantra_localizations_select_published.using: exists(select 1 from "mantras" m where m.id = "mantra_localizations"."mantra_id" and m.verification_status = 'published')

scripture_localizations_select_published.name: scripture_localizations_select_published
scripture_localizations_select_published.using: exists(select 1 from "scriptures" s where s.id = "scripture_localizations"."scripture_id" and s.verification_status = 'published')

scripture_section_localizations_select_p.name: scripture_section_localizations_select_published
scripture_section_localizations_select_p.using: exists(select 1 from "scripture_sections" sc join "scriptures" s on s.id = sc.scripture_id where sc.id = "scripture_section_localizations"."section_id" and s.verification_status = 'published')

scripture_sections_select_published.name: scripture_sections_select_published
scripture_sections_select_published.using: exists(select 1 from "scriptures" s where s.id = "scripture_sections"."scripture_id" and s.verification_status = 'published')

learning_modules_select_published.name: learning_modules_select_published
learning_modules_select_published.using: exists(select 1 from "learning_paths" l where l.id = "learning_modules"."learning_path_id" and l.verification_status = 'published')

learning_path_localizations_select_publi.name: learning_path_localizations_select_published
learning_path_localizations_select_publi.using: exists(select 1 from "learning_paths" l where l.id = "learning_path_localizations"."learning_path_id" and l.verification_status = 'published')

ai_conversations_select_own.name: ai_conversations_select_own
ai_conversations_select_own.using: user_id = auth.uid() and deleted_at is null

ai_message_citations_select_own.name: ai_message_citations_select_own
ai_message_citations_select_own.using: exists(select 1 from "ai_messages" m join "ai_conversations" c on c.id = m.conversation_id where m.id = "ai_message_citations"."message_id" and c.user_id = auth.uid() and c.deleted_at is null)

ai_messages_select_own.name: ai_messages_select_own
ai_messages_select_own.using: exists(select 1 from "ai_conversations" c where c.id = "ai_messages"."conversation_id" and c.user_id = auth.uid() and c.deleted_at is null)

ai_messages_insert_own.name: ai_messages_insert_own
ai_messages_insert_own.withCheck: exists(select 1 from "ai_conversations" c where c.id = "ai_messages"."conversation_id" and c.user_id = auth.uid())
